H4730.def: something to fume (incense) in, i.e. a coal-pan

H4731.def: a shoot, i.e. stick (with leaves on, or for walking, striking, guiding, divining)
H4731.deriv: or (feminine) מַקְּלָה; from an unused root meaning apparently to germinate;

H4732.def: Mikloth, a place in the Desert
senses: 1) one of the sons of Jehiel, the father or prince of Gibeon by his wife Maachah; a Benjamite
2) leader of the 2nd division of David's army

H4733.deriv: from {H7038} in the sense of taking in;

H4735.def: something bought, i.e. property, but only livestock; abstractly, acquisition
senses: 1a1) in general of a purchasable domestic animal
1b) cows, sheep, goats (in herds and flocks)
H4735.kjv: cattle, flock, herd, possession, purchase, substance.

H4736.def: properly, a buying, i.e. acquisition; concretely, a piece of property (land or living); also the sum paid
H4736.kjv: (he that is) bought, possession, piece, purchase.

senses: 1) one of the Levites of the 2nd rank, gatekeepers of the ark, appointed by David to play in the temple band
1) a place in Israel; site unknown
1) place of corner structure, corner buttress, inner corner-buttress
H4740.deriv: or מַקְצֹעַ; or (feminine) מַקְצֹעָה; from {H7106} in the denominative sense of bending;

H4741.def: a scraper, i.e. a carving chisel

senses: 1) place of corner structure, corner buttress, inner corner-buttress
H4742.deriv: from {H7106} in the denominative sense of bending;

H4743.def: to melt; figuratively, to flow, dwindle, vanish
senses: 1) to decay, pine away, rot, fester
H4743.kjv: consume away, be corrupt, dissolve, pine away.

H4744.def: something called out, i.e. a public meeting (the act, the persons, or the place); also a rehearsal
senses: 1) convocation, convoking, reading, a calling together

H4745.def: something met with, i.e. an accident or fortune
senses: 1) unforeseen meeting or event, accident, happening, chance, fortune
H4745.kjv: something befallen, befalleth, chance, event, hap(-peneth).

H4746.def: properly, something meeting, i.e. a frame (of timbers)

H4748.def: something turned (rounded), i.e. a curl (of tresses)
senses: 1) turned work, well-dressed hair, well-set hair, turner's work
1a) meaning uncertain; possible referring to artistry of the hairdo
H4748.deriv: from {H7185} in the sense of knotting up round and hard;

H4749.def: rounded work, i.e. moulded by hammering (repousse)
senses: 1) hammered work, finely decorated cultic objects of gold or silver
H4749.kjv: beaten (out of one piece, work), upright, whole piece.
